items.lede: Tells users ‘action required’ – but maybe don’t make that action a Jira ticket, because it has this bug
items.title: Atlassian warns of critical file access flaw in its datacenter products

items.lede: Atlassian is warning customers of a critical vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-21589, that can be exploited for arbitrary file-access in multiple self-hosted Data Center products, including Confluence, Jira, and Bitbucket. [...]
items.title: Atlassian warns of critical file-access flaw in Jira, Confluence
